'''Bing'ge''' is an NPC in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Bing'ge is located on the second floor of Hongzhen, near the south entrance.

==Profile==

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Bing'ge}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Bing'ge''' It's you, {{Rover}}. It's been a while.
:'''Bing'ge''' How's your trip so far? Hongzhen has changed a lot, hasn't it?
:{{DIcon}} It's a lot busier than before.
::'''Bing'ge''' Well, Hongzhen is what it is now, all thanks to you and the Magistrate.
:{{DIcon}} It's a lot safer than before.
::'''Bing'ge''' Yeah, thanks to you and our [[Jinhsi|Madam Magistrate]], the old Hongzhen is back.
:{{DIcon}} Not as much as I imagined.
::'''Bing'ge''' Haha, that is true. Hongzhen was a peaceful, happy town before the Temporal Disruption. 
::'''Bing'ge''' Yeah, thanks to you and our Madam Magistrate, the old Hongzhen is back.
:'''Bing'ge''' Oh, you should stick around longer this time. Try the [[Sagaci Springs]] or check out the Water Plums.
:'''Bing'ge''' Sorry I can't hang out with you this time. Lady [[Xinyi|Xinyi's]] got me joining up with the [[Midnight Rangers]] from Jinzhou, so I'll be pretty occupied for a while.
::{{DIcon}} Thank you. It's okay.
::{{DIcon}} I prefer to be alone, anyway.
:'''Bing'ge''' Sure! Anytime you need something, just hit me up. Happy to help always!
{{Dialogue End}}
